name: myRev_myRev
prelude:
def myRev : List α → List α
  | [] => []
  | x :: xs => myRev xs ++ [x]
statement: theorem myRev_myRev (xs : List α) : myRev (myRev xs) = xs
proofs:
have app : ∀ as bs : List α, myRev (as ++ bs) = myRev bs ++ myRev as := by
    intro as bs
    induction as with
    | nil => simp [myRev]
    | cons a as ih => simp [myRev, ih, List.append_assoc]
  induction xs with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons x xs ih => simp [myRev, app, ih]
  have snoc : ∀ (as : List α) (b : α), myRev (as ++ [b]) = b :: myRev as := by
    intro as b
    induction as with
    | nil => rfl
    | cons a as ih => rw [List.cons_append, myRev, ih, myRev, List.cons_append]
  induction xs with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons x xs ih => rw [myRev, snoc, ih]
